events.title: The Button Trail
events.description: Mismatched buttons form a trail across the grass.

choices.text: Follow the button trail
Leave 12 gold for two bundles of thread (+2 scraps)
Sell a button bundle (spend 1 scrap; gain 18 gold)

events.title: The Loose Seam
events.description: A strip of patched ground has come unstitched.

choices.text: Sew the seam (spend 1 scrap; recover 15 gold)
Walk around and gather loose thread (+1 scrap)
Reinforce the long tear (spend 2 scraps; gain 32 gold)

events.title: The Thimble Well
events.description: A silver thimble rests beside a dry stone well.

choices.text: Listen for loose thimbles (+1 scrap)
Find coins on the roadside (+5 gold)
Lower a spool line (spend 1 scrap; recover 18 gold)

events.title: The Frayed Signpost
events.description: Three cloth arrows flap from a crooked signpost.

choices.text: Patch the arrows (1 scrap for 10 gold)
Choose the clear path (+1 scrap)
Sell the stitched arrowwork (spend 2 scraps; gain 26 gold)

events.title: The Quiet Spool
events.description: An abandoned spool spins without a breeze.

choices.text: Watch the thread unwind
Leave the spool alone

events.title: The Needle Gate
events.description: Crossed needles mark a narrow wooden gate.

choices.text: Spend 1 scrap to unpick the gate and claim 12 gold
Pass without stopping
Cut the binding threads (spend 2 scraps; gain 28 gold)

events.title: The Quilting Bee
events.description: Neighbours gather around a half-sewn patchwork quilt, offering coins for help and spare thread for travellers.

choices.text: Sew a communal panel (spend 2 scraps; gain 32 gold)
Buy two thread bundles (spend 15 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Watch the neighbours stitch (+1 scrap)

events.title: Estate Sale
events.description: A travelling patchwork estate seller displays folded fabric lots beside a handcart.

choices.text: Buy a two-bundle thread lot (15 gold for 2 scraps)
Sell two salvaged scraps for 30 gold
Leave the estate sale

events.title: Lantern-Moth Clearing
events.description: Moths orbit a quilted lantern; abandoned silk spools glimmer in the grass.

choices.text: Gather loose silk (+1 scrap)
Trade 14 gold for two wick spools (+2 scraps)
Leave the moths undisturbed

events.title: The Patchwork Ferry
events.description: A cloth-sailed ferry rocks at a riverbank lined with cast-off rope.

choices.text: Pay 10 gold for a spare rope coil (+1 scrap)
Sell two scraps of salvaged rigging (+25 gold)
Take the long road

events.title: The Spool Clocktower
events.description: A crooked clock made of spools ticks above a deserted seamstress stall.

choices.text: Untangle six fallen coins (+6 gold)
Spend 1 scrap to fix the clock hand (+20 gold)
Ignore the chimes

events.title: The Ragpicker's Cart
events.description: A ragpicker sorts striped remnants into bundles beside a handcart.

choices.text: Buy a bundle for 20 gold (+3 scraps)
Sell two scraps of fine fabric (+29 gold)
Leave the cart

events.title: The Quilt Bridge
events.description: The river crossing is a suspended strip of embroidered quilt.

choices.text: Pick up a fallen stitch (+1 scrap)
Spend 1 scrap on the guardrail (+18 gold)
Exchange 12 gold for two thread bundles (+2 scraps)

events.title: The Button-Moon Festival
events.description: Travellers celebrate beneath a moon stitched from silver buttons.

choices.text: Find a dropped lucky coin (+5 gold)
Buy two ribbon bundles for 16 gold (+2 scraps)
Sell two scraps of festival fabric (+28 gold)

events.title: The Lost Thimble Ball
events.description: Under a velvet marquee, three button-eyed puppets waltz around a missing silver thimble.

choices.text: Return the thimble for 17 gold
Trade 12 gold for two ribbon scraps
Pass the velvet marquee

events.title: The Moonlace Tailor
events.description: A pale quiltmaker holds up moonlit lace, its hems fluttering against a great needle hoop.

choices.text: Sell two scraps for 31 gold
Gather dropped lace trimmings (+1 scrap)
Leave the tailor to the moonlight

events.title: The Copper-Bell Choir
events.description: Button-eyed ragdolls ring tiny copper bells beneath an oxblood awning.

choices.text: Sort the bell tags for 10 gold
Pay 14 gold for two cord scraps
Listen to the bells and go

events.title: Rooftop Stitch Market
events.description: A rope ladder climbs to a sewn rooftop where velvet-winged crows barter loose thread.

choices.text: Sell one scrap of fine fabric for 19 gold
Collect stray thread (+1 scrap)
Climb back down

events.title: The Torn Parasol Caravan
events.description: Patch-covered parasols shuffle along on tiny wooden feet through lantern fog.

choices.text: Repair the frames with two scraps for 27 gold
Pay 9 gold for one loose tassel scrap
Wave the caravan onward

events.title: The Silk-Mirror Fountain
events.description: A midnight fountain shows unsewn paths in its trembling silk reflection.

choices.text: Comb loose ribbons from the water (+1 scrap)
Give 20 gold for three dry spools (+3 scraps)
Turn away from the reflection

events.title: The Ghostlight Playhouse
events.description: Button-eyed actors bow beneath a lone amber candle in a theatre of torn oxblood velvet.

choices.text: Gather dropped costume ribbons (+2 scraps)
Rent the spare footlights (spend 17 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Close the velvet curtain and leave

events.title: The Frosted Pincushion
events.description: A mountain-sized pincushion bristles with icy needles while its brass pins ring like bells.

choices.text: Pull a loose copper pin (+12 gold)
Re-line a needle cap (spend 2 scraps; gain 26 gold)
Skirt the frozen cushion and leave

events.title: The Threadbare Aviary
events.description: Clockwork felt birds rustle in a stitched cage whose roof has lost its final seam.

choices.text: Gather soft feather stuffing (+1 scrap)
Buy cage-repair thread (spend 13 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Let the birds rest and leave

events.title: The Oxblood Moss Garden
events.description: Plush midnight roses bloom from the stitched pockets of a wandering quilt garden.

choices.text: Collect clipped rose hems (+1 scrap)
Trade one saved scrap for a rose ribbon (spend 1 scrap; gain 18 gold)
Walk out through the moss gate

events.title: The Cloud-Hem Windmill
events.description: A patchwork windmill turns its broad cloud-patterned sails above a valley of sewn grasses.

choices.text: Crank the spare spool for wages (+7 gold)
Sell two sailcloth scraps (spend 2 scraps; gain 32 gold)
Watch the sails turn and leave

events.title: The Stone Button Forge
events.description: A giant button-eyed smith hammers moon-bright brass circles on an embroidered anvil.

choices.text: Sweep stray button shanks (+2 scraps)
Buy three spools of thread-steel (spend 21 gold; gain 3 scraps)
Leave the forge before the next bell

events.title: The Stitched Fog Carousel
events.description: Button-eyed hobbyhorses circle a silent quilt carousel while amber lanterns disappear into the fog.

choices.text: Collect the dropped brass tickets (+11 gold)
Pay 13 gold for two bundles of carousel stitching (+2 scraps)
Watch the horses disappear (Leave)

events.title: The Rust-Bell Laundry
events.description: Tiny ragdoll washerfolk hang oxblood coats under a rusted bell that tolls whenever the wind changes.

choices.text: Gather clean discarded fabric (+2 scraps)
Re-hem the work smocks (spend 2 scraps; gain 29 gold)
Keep to the dry road (Leave)

events.title: The Inky Needle Orchard
events.description: A grove of midnight-blue pincushion trees bears blunt silver needles instead of fruit.

choices.text: Gather loose needle stems (+1 scrap)
Pay the orchard keeper 16 gold for three thread spools (+3 scraps)
Pass between the silent trees (Leave)

events.title: The Silver-Spool Circus
events.description: A lantern-lit puppet circus unfurls its silver-thread tent across the moonlit road.

choices.text: Rig the shadow curtain (spend 1 scrap; earn 21 gold)
Buy a stitched seat ribbon (spend 10 gold; gain 1 scrap)
Skip the midnight performance (Leave)

events.title: The Thorned Pocket Library
events.description: A rolling bookcase with button wheels carries tiny stitched books beneath a crown of woollen briars.

choices.text: Rebind the torn volumes (spend 2 scraps; earn 30 gold)
Collect a loose embroidered bookmark (+1 scrap)
Leave the books undisturbed (Leave)

events.title: The Amber-Hem Undertaker
events.description: A gentle button-eyed doll tends lanterns beside a ceremonial velvet quilt, carefully stitching its frayed edge.

choices.text: Repair the velvet hem (spend 1 scrap; gain 18 gold)
Buy two spare lantern wicks (spend 15 gold; gain 2 scraps)
Offer a respectful bow (Leave)

events.title: The Stormglass Seam Survey
events.description: A one-eyed ragdoll surveyor pins weathered maps beneath a lamp of midnight glass.

choices.text: Copy a storm atlas for the road (+11 gold)
Buy waterproof seam thread (-14 gold, +2 scraps)
Shelter from the storm and leave

events.title: The Ironbutton Tidepool
events.description: Tin-button shells rattle against a quilted seawall beneath a cold button moon.

choices.text: Gather washed-up sea-thread (+2 scraps)
Trade one spare rigging scrap (+17 gold, -1 scrap)
Leave the tidepool undisturbed

events.title: The Needle-Moon Bakery
events.description: A velvet ragdoll baker pulls bread-shaped pincushions from a glowing thimble oven.

choices.text: Carry the quilted bread baskets (+12 gold)
Buy oven-proof twine (-13 gold, +2 scraps)
Walk past the warm windows

events.title: The Velvet Kite Roost
events.description: Button-eyed cloth kites snag in a blackthorn tree beside the candlelit road.

choices.text: Retie two kite tails (-2 scraps, +29 gold)
Gather fallen kite knots (+1 scrap)
Leave the kites to the wind

events.title: The Mossbutton Weather Station
events.description: A moss-green button-doll keeps a storm vane spinning atop a patched roof.

choices.text: Repair the wind vane (-1 scrap, +19 gold)
Buy stormward thread (-16 gold, +2 scraps)
Leave the weather station

events.title: The Ragdoll Bell Foundry
events.description: Toy foundry workers hammer tiny brass bells in a furnace-lit felt workshop.

choices.text: Polish the bell clappers (-2 scraps, +31 gold)
Sweep up brass ribbons (+1 scrap)
Leave the foundry before nightfall
